summary: Picked feed-quality-gate at random from the rotation repos (no prior cloud-creative run to avoid repeating). Idea: a self-contained HTML report (`fqg check --html`) with a score gauge and a colour-coded PASS/FAIL/WARN table, alongside the existing JSON/console/Markdown renderers. Wrote the goal/success-check file before any code, built it with tests (59 passed, up from 56; escaping of untrusted feed content verified with an injected <script>/onerror payload), opened PR #4, and had a fresh Opus subagent independently verify all 5 success checks by actually running them (VERIFIED, no failures). CI went green and the PR merged.
